ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets clustered in a large heap on the left half of the plate, smooth moist surfaces with slight golden tinge at edges, soft and tender-looking, bite-sized florets about 2-4 cm each, sitting directly on the plate with no sauce | 230
ITEM 2 | Cubes of golden-brown pan-fried firm material on the upper right of the plate, edges browned and slightly crisp, cubes roughly 2-2.5 cm square, scattered with small crumbly brown bits and a few green specks nearby | 110
ITEM 3 | Two elongated oval patties or slices of dense brown-grey meat-like mixture on the lower right, about 7-8 cm long and 3 cm wide each, surface browned with darker crusty edges and some green flecks visible, firm and holding shape | 130
ITEM 4 | Scattered small crumbs and bits of brown, dry, crumbly texture around the cubes and patties on the right side, with a few darker specks, appearing dry with no sheen | 10
